title: Media God Mobile
message: Media God Mobile 1.0.6 adds a broad compatibility decoder fallback for difficult video and audio formats while keeping Android hardware/Media3 decoding first. It improves playback for DTS/DTS-HD, TrueHD/MLP, ALAC, FLAC, Opus/Vorbis, MPEG audio, legacy MPEG-4/DivX/Xvid/VC-1 and unusual MKV/AVI/TS combinations, with wider container detection and automatic fallback only when the normal decoder cannot play the source.
